description: A quadruped mobility movement alternating spinal flexion and extension to release spinal stiffness and activate core musculature.
setup: Start on hands and knees with wrists directly under shoulders and knees under hips in table position.
steps: Inhale, drop belly toward the floor, tilt pelvis anteriorly, and look gently upward (Cow pose).
Exhale, press hands into floor, round spine upward toward the ceiling, and tuck chin to chest (Cat pose).
Flow fluidly between both positions, coordinating breath with spinal articulation.
cues: Move vertebra by vertebra through the entire spine
Push the floor away with your palms at the top of Cat

mistakes.mistake: Cranking neck excessively backward during Cow
mistakes.fix: Keep cervical spine long, gazing softly forward rather than forcing neck back
Keep arms straight and locked, driving movement through shoulders and spine

rep_standard: One complete cycle of full spinal extension (Cow) and full flexion (Cat) counts as one repetition
